claim: A replacement checked only on recorded inputs can pass while wrong on rare paths; add random and edge-value sweeps and failing mutants, and gate every redraw rather than a sample.

evidence.text: Two of four mutants passed every recorded call and failed only on random or edge inputs; a missed stage (sector cull 0x8D4F) showed as one wrong cube in one of 5,233 redraws, which a sample would have missed.
